lines.para: For nearly ten years, the FBI watched a network of illegals planted in the United States by Russian foreign intelligence. On 27 June 2010, it arrested ten people. The names they lived under:

lines.text: 1. Richard and Cynthia Murphy, in Montclair (New Jersey).
2. Donald Heathfield and Tracey Foley, in Cambridge (Massachusetts).
3. Juan Lazaro and Vicky Peláez, in Yonkers (New York).
4. Michael Zottoli and Patricia Mills, in Virginia.

lines.para: An eleventh man, who handled the network’s money, was arrested two days later in Cyprus. Released on bail, he vanished.
